about.body:
This is a collection of panoramic and long-exposure landscape photography, shot largely across New Zealand along with a handful of images from further afield. Most of the work is stitched from multiple exposures to capture the kind of wide field of view that a single frame can't hold — the panoramic format is the point, and every image here is best viewed zoomed in.

Prints and digital downloads of the full-resolution files will be available soon through an Etsy shop — a link will appear on each image once that's live.
